notes.title: Update 0.0.55
notes.content:
This is a larger update, although some of the changes are behind the scenes! As always, thank you for helping with my early testing and I appreciate any feedback!

Changes in this update:
[list]
[*] Updated the stat panel on the pause menu to show more accurate statistics as you build your ship
[*] Changed how crew work. They no longer are directional, instead they operate one of 4 positions: Captain, Pilot, Gunner, or Engineer. Each crewmember has unique stats and abilities depending on the position they are assigned. Their abilities affect all weapons equally, regardless of their side.
[*] Added DPS tracking - which should be displayed on the death screen
[*] Added discord link in the main menu. (Join if you haven't already!)
[*] Added level selection screen with the game's namesake: a warp gate!
[*] Adjusted spawn rates of enemies, planets, drops, money, XP, etc.
[*] Adjusted some fonts and UI elements
[*] Fixed bug with crew damage multipliers working inconsistently
[*] Updated the library assets with new artwork
[*] Various behind-the-scenes performance improvements, particularly on Steam Deck
[*] Added more video settings and adjustments in the settings screen
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.050
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added new weapon: shotgun
[*] Fixed bug where pause was still functional during level-up
[*] Greatly improved physics performance. Especially useful on lower-end devices
[*] Added level to black hole weapon which changes size of black holes
[*] Fixed bugs in how quantum damage was being implemented
[*] Fixed bug where crew modifiers weren't properly applying to newly leveled weapons
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.047
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Improved weapon VFX 
[*] Improved performance of multiple asteroids on screen
[*] Added new component: multi-shot (level ups en route)
[*] Fixed bug where enemies shot despite being killed
[*] Fixed flickering in background stars
[*] Post processing adjustments for better visual fidelity
[*] Reworked some of main menu UI and added new logo
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.045
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Updated RNG generation to fix bug where maps were not randomized
[*]Updated the lootbox animation and code to reduce bugs
[*]Input changes are now saved to the disk
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.0.43
notes.content:
Thank you to everyone for your feedback and time!

Changes:
-Added a treasure chest pickup
-Pickup shows on minimap
-Adjusted star/planet textures in main menu to make them slower
-Feedback report box now wraps text
-Added rewards to mission descriptions
-Implemented loading system to reduce stuttering in-game while assets load
-Added asteroids throughout map
-Added audio output settings
-Added input mapping
-Asteroids now have change to drop money
-Lowered mission kill thresholds significantly to ensure crew is unlocked faster
-Overall performance improvements
-Fixed bug where asteroids didn't take bullet damage
